## ROLEPLAY RULES - These apply during gameplay.
- [textlink="1. Abide by MRP standards." link="RuleRSR1"] - [textlink="2. Don't act like an antagonist unless the game says you are one." link="RuleRSR2"] - [textlink="3. As a crew-aligned non-antagonist, follow reasonable escalation." link="RuleRSR3"] - [textlink="4. Don't interfere with players joining, leaving, or ending the round." link="RuleRSR4"] - [textlink="5. You are expected to roleplay without breaking immersion." link="RuleRSR5"] - [textlink="6. Don't use information gained outside of in-character means." link="RuleRSR6"] - [textlink="7. Do not metagame; Obey the Metashield." link="RuleRSR7"] - [textlink="8. Don't give unfair treatment based on who is playing a character." link="RuleRSR8"] - [textlink="9. Listen to your team leader and don't abandon your role." link="RuleRSR9"] \n
